How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 15.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic urban realism, a continuous first-person tracking shot begins from the exact position, framing, perspective, and environment established by Picture 1: the young adult woman walks ahead beneath the roadside trees while her outstretched hand holds the camera-holder’s black-sleeved hand in the lower foreground. Her facial identity, long wavy black hair, oversized cream-and-light-blue knitted sweater, black shorts, black lace-up boots, body proportions, and clothing remain completely consistent throughout the full 15-second shot. During the opening seconds, she maintains eye contact with the lens and gently loosens her fingers one by one; their hands separate naturally, her arm swings forward, and the camera-holder’s hand lowers out of frame. She turns her face and shoulders toward the direction of travel and continues walking forward along the tactile paving while the first-person camera follows directly behind her at the same walking speed, maintaining a natural handheld footstep sway and a consistent distance. After several steps, she turns her head and upper body back over her shoulder while continuing to walk forward, looks directly into the lens, and gives a subtle smile as her long hair swings across the back of her sweater. She then turns forward again and continues toward the intersection as the tree-lined sidewalk opens into the zebra crossing; storefronts, tree trunks, parked red three-wheeled vehicles, and passing road traffic shift naturally through continuous perspective parallax. As she reaches the crossing, she slows down, steps onto a white stripe, and turns her entire body smoothly to face the camera while the camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed. She completes the turn, lowers both arms naturally beside her body, places one boot slightly in front of the other, and holds calm eye contact as the moving camera settles into the full-body distance, position, street layout, red vehicle placement, tree arrangement, lighting, pose, and final composition established by Picture 2 at exactly 15.00 seconds.

overall_soundscape: Her boots produce steady, distinct footsteps across the sidewalk tiles and painted crossing while knitted sleeves brush softly and leaves rustle above. Nearby traffic passes continuously with low engine noise, occasional tire sounds, a distant horn, and faint street ambience, while the camera-holder’s footsteps remain synchronized with the tracking movement.

non_diegetic_music: A soft fingerpicked acoustic-guitar pattern plays at a moderate-slow tempo with widely spaced muted-piano notes. A light sustained string layer enters when she looks back, then decreases gently in volume as she reaches the final pose.
